Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc. (the “Company” or “Registrant”) is a Canadian public company whose common shares are listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol “NOU” and the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) under the symbol “NMG.” The Company is eligible to file its annual report pursuant to Section 13 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), on Form 40-F pursuant to the multijurisdictional disclosure system of the Exchange Act (“MJDS”). The Company is a “foreign private issuer” as defined in Rule 3b- 4 under the Exchange Act. Equity securities of the Company are accordingly exempt from Sections 14(a), 14(b), 14(c), 14(f) and 16 of the Exchange Act pursuant to Rule 3a12-3.
